pairs.target: dìèrtiān bàngwǎn , tǎ wéi zài gōngyòng chángwū zhǎodào mǐlā , tā jiāng jǐkuài mùpiàn tān le yìzhuō , zhèng tóng yīwén zhēng yìtiáo lánxiàn jiūjìng suàn hé háishì lù .
pairs.english: The next evening, Tavi found Mira in the shared longhouse; she had spread several wooden pieces over a table and was arguing with Iven over whether a blue line counted as a river or a road.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天傍晚，塔维在公用长屋找到米拉，她将几块木片摊了一桌，正同伊文争一条蓝线究竟算河还是路。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén liàng gāng xǐ guò de yīshang , dīshuǐ luò zài shícáolǐ , yīwén jiāng zìjǐ de xiùzi wǎng zhuō lǐ shōu le shōu , réng bùkěn bǎ yāzhù de mùpiàn ràng chūlái .
pairs.english: Outside the window someone was hanging the freshly washed clothes; dripping water fell into a stone trough, and Iven drew his own sleeves inward across the table a little, still refusing to give up the wooden piece held down beneath them.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人晾刚洗过的衣裳，滴水落在石槽里，伊文将自己的袖子往桌里收了收，仍不肯把压住的木片让出来。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànjiàn tǎ wéi , xiān zhǐ le kàoqiáng de dèng , ràng tā zuò wěn , cái bǎ zhǎng xīnlǐ nà zhī xiǎodōngxī fàngdào tā miànqián .
pairs.english: Mira saw Tavi and first pointed to the stool against the wall, letting him sit securely before placing the little thing from her palm in front of him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看见塔维，先指了靠墙的凳，让他坐稳，才把掌心里那只小东西放到他面前。

pairs.target: shì zhī bēizhe tuó jià de yáng , ěrduo yìchángyìduǎn , sìjiǎo què lìde wěn , tǎ wéi rènchū tā qián xiē rì zài táijiē shàng xiāo de nà kuài mùtou , rěnbúzhù shēn zhǐ mōlemō .
pairs.english: It was a goat carrying a packsaddle, with one long ear and one short, but all four feet stood firmly; Tavi recognised the piece of wood she had carved on the steps some days earlier and could not resist reaching out a finger to stroke it.
pairs.hanzi: 是只背着驮架的羊，耳朵一长一短，四脚却立得稳，塔维认出她前些日在台阶上削的那块木头，忍不住伸指摸了摸。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiānqián cāi shuǐhú , chà de yě búsuàn yuǎn . "
pairs.english: “Your earlier guess was a kettle; the difference was not so great, either.”
pairs.hanzi: “你先前猜水壶，差得也不算远。”

pairs.target: mǐlā jiāng yáng zhuǎnguò qù , tǎ wéi cái fāxiàn tuó jià qiánhòu zhuāng fǎn le , yīwén shuō zhè zhèngshì tā bùkěn zàihuò de yuángù , tā jiào tā biétì yáng shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Mira turned the goat around; only then did Tavi discover that the packsaddle had been fitted back to front; Iven said this was precisely why it refused to carry goods, and she told him not to speak for the goat.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉将羊转过去，塔维才发现驮架前后装反了，伊文说这正是它不肯载货的缘故，她叫他别替羊说话。

pairs.target: zhè zhāng huà zài jiù bǎn shàng de xínglù tú shì chángwū yuányǒu de , jǐgè dìfāng dōu módiào le yánsè , mùpiàn shì jīnwǎn nálái bǔquē de qízǐ , búshì gōngfáng yào jiāo de yàngjiàn .
pairs.english: This route map drawn on an old board already belonged to the longhouse; several places had all lost their colour through wear, and the wooden pieces were counters brought tonight to replace missing ones, rather than samples due at the workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 这张画在旧板上的行路图是长屋原有的，几个地方都磨掉了颜色，木片是今晚拿来补缺的棋子，不是工房要交的样件。

pairs.target: guījǔ xiě zài bǎn bèi , zhì xiǎo mùkuài zǒulù , guòdù kǒu yào děng yìlún , dào le xiējiǎo péng cái kě bǎ shǒulǐ de huò huànchéng fēnshù .
pairs.english: The rules were written on the board's back: throw the small wooden block to travel, and at a ferry crossing you must wait a round; only upon reaching a wayside shelter could the goods in your hand be exchanged for points.
pairs.hanzi: 规矩写在板背，掷小木块走路，过渡口要等一轮，到了歇脚棚才可把手里的货换成分数。

pairs.target: mǐlā yào yáng , yī wénxuǎn yìzhī méi kè wán de biǎn chuán , tǎ wéi ná le zuìxiǎo de mù rén , tóudǐng yǒu yídào xiāo wāi de hén , tā shuō xiàng zìjǐ jiǎn huài le tóufa .
pairs.english: Mira wanted the goat, Iven chose one unfinished little boat, and Tavi took the smallest wooden figure; there was a crooked cut on its head, which he said looked like himself after getting his hair cut badly.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉要羊，伊文选一只没刻完的扁船，塔维拿了最小的木人，头顶有一道削歪的痕，他说像自己剪坏了头发。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ dèng wǎng lǐ nuó , gěi duān fàn de rén liúxià guò dào , tǎ wéi jiāng zuǒtuǐ shēn dào zhuōxià , búyòng pán qǐlái , biàn yě méi juéde qiān tòng .
pairs.english: They moved the stools inward to leave a passage for people carrying meals; Tavi stretched his left leg under the table, without having to fold it up, and so felt no pulling pain either.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把凳往里挪，给端饭的人留下过道，塔维将左腿伸到桌下，不用盘起来，便也没觉得牵痛。

pairs.target: tóu yìlún yīwén lián zǒu liǎngchù shānlù , piān bú qù jìn de dùkǒu , tǎ wéi wèn tā búshì zuì rènde chuán me , tā zhǐzhe mó bái de lánxiàn shuō , rènde cái bú qù .
pairs.english: In the first round Iven took two mountain stretches in succession, deliberately avoiding the nearby ferry; Tavi asked whether he did not know boats best, and he pointed at the blue line worn white, saying that knowing them was exactly why he stayed away.
pairs.hanzi: 头一轮伊文连走两处山路，偏不去近的渡口，塔维问他不是最认得船么，他指着磨白的蓝线说，认得才不去。

pairs.target: lún dào tǎ wéi , mùkuài gěi le tā sìbù , dùkǒu yòu jìn , tā bǎ mù rén tuīguòqù , mǐlā suíshǒu fānkāi yípiàn jìshì pái , shàngmiàn shì fēng tíng dù sāngè zì .
pairs.english: When Tavi's turn came, the block gave him four steps and the ferry was close too; he pushed the wooden figure across, and Mira casually turned over an event tile, bearing the three characters for wind halts ferry.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到塔维，木块给了他四步，渡口又近，他把木人推过去，米拉随手翻开一片记事牌，上面是风停渡三个字。

pairs.target: yīwén méi xiào chū shēng , xiān dītóu bǎ zìjǐ nà zhī chuán bǎizhèng , tǎ wéi wàng zhe tā jiānbǎng , wèn shìbushì zǎo zhīdào pái duī lǐ yǒu zhè yìzhāng .
pairs.english: Iven did not laugh aloud, first lowering his head to straighten his own particular boat; Tavi watched his shoulders and asked whether he had known beforehand that this one was in the tile stack.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没笑出声，先低头把自己那只船摆正，塔维望着他肩膀，问是不是早知道牌堆里有这一张。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiǎoshíhòu wán guò lìng yìfú , nàlǐ tíng dù yào děng liǎnglún , zhèlǐ zhǐ děng yìlún , yǐjīng suàn kuānhòu le , suíhòu háishì xiào le chūlái .
pairs.english: He said he had played another version as a child, where a ferry halt meant waiting two rounds; here you waited only one round, which already counted as generous, and then he laughed after all.
pairs.hanzi: 他说小时候玩过另一幅，那里停渡要等两轮，这里只等一轮，已经算宽厚了，随后还是笑了出来。

pairs.target: mǐlā hěnkuài zhuī shàng , bǎ yáng fàngjìn xiējiǎo péng , ná qǐ jìfēn mù qiān shí , tǎ wéi hūrán shēnshǒu , zhǐ zhù bǎn bèi nà xíng xiǎozì .
pairs.english: Mira soon caught up, placing the goat in a wayside shelter; as she picked up a scoring stick, Tavi suddenly reached out and pointed to that line of small writing on the board's back.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉很快追上，把羊放进歇脚棚，拿起记分木签时，塔维忽然伸手，指住板背那行小字。

pairs.target: pénglǐ zhǐnéng shōu liáng , tā nà piàn huò shàng huà de shì yán , mǐlā dītóu kàn le bànshǎng , shuō huà de tài xiàng shítou , jiào yīwén bié chènjī gǎichéng shítou .
pairs.english: The shelter could accept only grain, while her cargo tile was painted as salt; Mira looked down at it for a good while, saying the drawing looked too much like stone and telling Iven not to take the opportunity to turn it into stone.
pairs.hanzi: 棚里只能收粮，她那片货上画的是盐，米拉低头看了半晌，说画得太像石头，叫伊文别趁机改成石头。

pairs.target: pángbiān cā bēizi de xuéshēng tīngjiàn , tàntóu shuō nánbiān de guījǔ zǎo gǎi le , yán yě néng jiāo , yīwén qǐng tā zhǐ gěi dàjiā kàn , tā fānguò bǎn , zhǎo búdào .
pairs.english: A student wiping cups nearby heard and leaned over, saying the southern rules had changed long ago and salt could be handed in too; Iven asked him to point it out for everyone to inspect, but he turned the board over and could not find it.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边擦杯子的学生听见，探头说南边的规矩早改了，盐也能交，伊文请他指给大家看，他翻过板，找不到。

pairs.target: xuéshēng shuō zìjǐ zhēn wán guò nàyàng de , mǐlā biàn bǎ nà piàn yán shōuhuí lái , shuō děng tā zhǎo zháo lìng yìzhāng bǎn zài suàn , zhèhuí xiānzhào yǎnqián de .
pairs.english: The student said he really had played that kind; Mira then took the salt tile back, saying they would count it once he found the other board, and for this game would first follow the one before them.
pairs.hanzi: 学生说自己真玩过那样的，米拉便把那片盐收回来，说等他找着另一张板再算，这回先照眼前的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng wán tíng dù , zhōngyú guòhé , mù rén què liúzài méiyǒu péng de xiǎo lùshang , shǒulǐ liǎngpiàn huò dōu sòng bù chūqù , tā xiānqián zhǐ shù le jìnlù , méi shù zǒu dào nǎér néng xiē .
pairs.english: After waiting out the ferry halt, Tavi finally crossed the river, but his wooden figure remained on a little path with no shelter, unable to deliver both of the two cargo tiles in his hand; earlier he had counted only the short route, not counted where he could rest along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等完停渡，终于过河，木人却留在没有棚的小路上，手里两片货都送不出去，他先前只数了近路，没数走到哪儿能歇。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ mù rén niē qǐlái , duì zhe dìtú zhuǎn le bàntiān , piānpiān tā tóushàng nà dào wāi hén yě xiàng zài xiào , mǐlā cuī tā , tā cái bǎ qízǐ fàng huí yuánchù .
pairs.english: Tavi picked up the wooden figure and turned it before the map for ages; even the crooked mark on its head seemed to be laughing at him, and only when Mira urged him along did he put the counter back where it had been.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把木人捏起来，对着地图转了半天，偏偏它头上那道歪痕也像在笑，米拉催他，他才把棋子放回原处。

pairs.target: tā lìng zǒu liǎngbù , mǐlā yǐ jiāng yáng wǎng shānjǐ shàngtuī , yīwén shēnshǒu yào dǎng , tā tái yǎn wèn zhè yòu shì nǎtiáo guījǔ , tā zhǐhǎo shōu shǒu .
pairs.english: He took two more steps; Mira was already pushing the goat up onto the ridge when Iven reached out to block it; she looked up and asked which rule this was now, and he had no choice but to withdraw his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他另走两步，米拉已将羊往山脊上推，伊文伸手要挡，她抬眼问这又是哪条规矩，他只好收手。

pairs.target: yáng de tuó jià suī fǎn , fānguò shānkǒu dǎo bǐ chuán zǎo , mǐlā jiāng zuìhòu yìzhī mù qiān lā dào miànqián , yòng zhǐjié qiāo le yíxià , jiào tāmen rènshū .
pairs.english: Though the goat's packsaddle was backward, it crossed the pass earlier than the boat; Mira pulled the last wooden scoring stick, a token, in front of herself, tapped it once with a knuckle, and told them to concede.
pairs.hanzi: 羊的驮架虽反，翻过山口倒比船早，米拉将最后一支木签拉到面前，用指节敲了一下，叫他们认输。

pairs.target: " hái méiwán , nǐ qiàn wǒ yìlún . "
pairs.english: “It is not over yet; you owe me a round.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没完，你欠我一轮。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng mùkuài lǒng huílái , rènzhēn zhì le , zǒu wán shèngxià liǎngbù , réng bǐ tā shǎo yìfēn , mǐlā zhè cái kěn jiāng yáng jǔ gāo yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi gathered the wooden block back, threw it in earnest, and completed the remaining two steps, still one point fewer than her; only then was Mira willing to lift the goat a little higher.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将木块拢回来，认真掷了，走完剩下两步，仍比她少一分，米拉这才肯将羊举高一点。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō xiàcì yào zhǎo zhāng yǒu shuǐlù de , mǐlā shuō zhè jiù yǒu , tā shuō yào chuán néng zǒu de , búshì zhuān gěi yáng kàn de lánxiàn .
pairs.english: Iven said next time he wanted to find a board with waterways on it; Mira said this one indeed had them, and he said he wanted ones boats could use, rather than blue lines made exclusively for goats to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说下次要找张有水路的，米拉说这就有，他说要船能走的，不是专给羊看的蓝线。

pairs.target: chuāng biān de yīshang búzài dīshuǐ , duān fàn de rén yǐjīng zǒu jìn , cā bēizi de xuéshēng yòu lái , shǒulǐ ná zhe cóng guì dǐng fān chū de lìng yìzhāng jiù bǎn .
pairs.english: The clothes by the window no longer dripped, and the people carrying meals had all gone; the student wiping cups came back, holding another old board he had dug out from the cupboard top.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边的衣裳不再滴水，端饭的人已经走尽，擦杯子的学生又来，手里拿着从柜顶翻出的另一张旧板。

pairs.target: nà shàngtóu shuǐlù duō de xiàng chán zài yìqǐ de xiàn , shānjǐ què zhǐ huà le bànbiān , tā déyì de wǎng zhuōshàng yí fàng , wèn zhè yìzhāng hái rèn bu rèn .
pairs.english: On it the waterways were so numerous they resembled tangled thread, while only half the ridges were drawn; he set it triumphantly on the table and asked whether they would still accept this one.
pairs.hanzi: 那上头水路多得像缠在一起的线，山脊却只画了半边，他得意地往桌上一放，问这一张还认不认。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu lìkè dá , jiāng mù yáng gē zài liǎngzhāng bǎn zhījiān , xiān qù kàn bèihòu de zì , tǎ wéi bǎ dèng nuókāi yìdiǎn , ràng xīn lái de rén yě néng zuòxià .
pairs.english: Mira did not answer at once, setting the wooden goat between the two boards and first going to read the writing on the back; Tavi moved his stool aside a little so the newly arrived person could sit down too.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有立刻答，将木羊搁在两张板之间，先去看背后的字，塔维把凳挪开一点，让新来的人也能坐下。

pairs.target: yīwén shēnshǒu tiāo chuán , tǎ wéi wèn tā zuǒshǒu bèi zěnyàng , tā fānguò shǒu ràng tā kàn , shuō yǐjīng búbì bāo zhe , bié jiè zhège jiào zìjǐ shǎo zhì yìhuí .
pairs.english: Iven reached for the boat; Tavi asked how the back was on his left hand, and he turned his hand over to show him, saying it no longer needed wrapping and not to use this to make him miss a throw.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文伸手挑船，塔维问他左手背怎样，他翻过手让他看，说已经不必包着，别借这个叫自己少掷一回。

pairs.target: nà diǎn cāshāng hái liú zhe qiǎn hén , tǎ wéi méiyǒu pèng , zhuǎntóu kàn mǐlā , tā yǐ jièzhe dēng dú dào dìsānháng , méitóu zhòu de bǐ zuògōng shí hái jǐn .
pairs.english: The scrape still left a faint mark; Tavi did not touch it and turned to Mira, who had already read to the third line by lamplight, her brow furrowed even more tightly than when working.
pairs.hanzi: 那点擦伤还留着浅痕，塔维没有碰，转头看米拉，她已借着灯读到第三行，眉头皱得比做工时还紧。

pairs.target: " yán zhèhuí zhēn néng jiāo . "
pairs.english: “Salt really can be handed in this time.”
pairs.hanzi: “盐这回真能交。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , bǎ yáng tuīhuí zìjǐ miànqián , méiyǒu huàn chuán , tǎ wéi jiāng mù rén liúzài shǒubiān , tīngjiàn yīwén zhōngyú xiào chū le shēng .
pairs.english: When she finished speaking, she pushed the goat back in front of herself without switching to a boat; Tavi kept the wooden figure beside him and heard Iven finally laugh aloud.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，把羊推回自己面前，没有换船，塔维将木人留在手边，听见伊文终于笑出了声。
